findings.evidence: Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Semisimple.lean:165 provides `IsSemisimple.restrict`, so each restricted operator is semisimple; the PR's lines 175–181 already perform simultaneous decomposition on these restrictions. In finite-dimensional `p`, semisimplicity supplies eigenspace exhaustion directly, without `Module.End.genEigenspace_restrict_eq_top` or ambient finite-dimensionality.
findings.fix: Replace the ambient instance with `[FiniteDimensional K p]`, remove `htop`, and diagonalize the restricted family; propagate the weaker signature to `iSup_inf_iInf_eigenspace_charHom_of_invariant`.
findings.issue: `iSup_inf_iInf_eigenspace_of_invariant` unnecessarily requires `[FiniteDimensional K V]` and `htop`; only the invariant submodule `p` must be finite-dimensional. This also over-specializes the character-indexed theorem at line 212.

summary: The invariant-submodule decomposition retains redundant ambient hypotheses and excludes the natural finite-dimensional-submodule case.
